title: FLA asset round-trip data loss: MIME types, missing-asset guard
description: Two silent data-loss bugs in packages/core/src/fla/zip.ts: (1) loadFla hardcodes restored data URIs to image/png / audio/mpeg (zip.ts:96-104) — JPEG/GIF bitmaps (model supports compressionType photo) and WAV sounds come back mislabeled; preserve the original MIME (store it in the manifest or asset filename extension). (2) If an asset zip entry is missing on load, the item keeps its asset: placeholder dataUri; on the NEXT save the !startsWith(asset:) guard writes no bytes — the asset is gone forever with no error (zip.ts:41-56). Fail loudly or preserve the entry. Extend the round-trip tests to cover non-PNG/non-MP3 assets. See docs/15-file-formats-fla-swf.md.
